name: Shirasagi Eri
source:
One of [url=https://vndb.org/c20897]Yukiha[/url]'s classmates. She likes girls more than boys.

On top of being smart, she has a laid-back personality, and is very caring. Because of this, she is very popular with girls.

She is [url=https://vndb.org/c20869]Yukitsuki[/url]'s best friend, and met Yukiha through her. She's willing to work with Yukiha, for Yukitsuki and [url=https://vndb.org/c20868]Haya[/url]'s sake.

[spoiler]In her route, Yukiha gives her the nickname "Eri-cake".[/spoiler]
